categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet maintainer label and modifies wallet transaction caching and notification logic in src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Removes obsolete cache invalidation and GUI notification logic left redundant after #27286. As the author notes, CWalletTx caches only transaction-specific amounts that do not change upon spending, making MarkInputsDirty recompute the same values and trigger unnecessary UI refreshes.
